figurative_meaning_en: Bearing the responsibility of a costly or burdensome task
similar_in_english: White elephant (a burdensome and expensive possession)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে হাতী পোষার মতো একটা বড় প্রকল্পের দায়িত্ব নিয়েছে, যা তার সামর্থ্যের বাইরে।
ঘর বাঁধার পর হাতী পোষা শুরু করলে পরিবারের অবস্থা খারাপ হয়ে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has taken on a project like rearing an elephant, which is beyond his means.
Starting to keep an elephant after building a house will ruin the family's finances.
history: This idiom draws from the historical context in rural Bengal where maintaining an elephant was a luxury only affordable by zamindars or kings, symbolizing extravagant and unsustainable expenses.
note: The idiom highlights the cultural view of elephants as symbols of wealth and high maintenance costs in traditional Bengali society.
